Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for compounds in document CHEMBL1122107. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1122107'. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
